sentences.text:
2. Charge sheet is filed against the accused persons for the offence punishable under Sections 498A,
504, 506 r/w 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
respectively.

Accused Nos.1 to 5 had preferred Crl.P.No.101749/2017 seeking similar prayer to quash the proceedings and the said petition was considered on merits and dismissed vide order dated 10.03.2021.
4.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the matter arise out of a matrimonial dispute between respondent No.2 and her husband i.e., accused No.1 and other accused are the relatives of accused No.1.
Crl.P.No.101749/2017 preferred by the petitioners has been already dismissed on merits.
It was observed therein that since the criminal proceedings arise out of a matrimonial dispute, it is always open for the parties to file a fresh petition in the event of any settlement.
It is not the case of the petitioners that settlement has taken place.
Further, the police after conducting investigation have filed the charge sheet.
In that view of the matter, no grounds are made out to quash the proceedings.
The petitioners are at liberty to seek discharge before the trial Court, if they are so advised.
